baseline.label: superpowers only
baseline.instruction: Use the superpowers skills as they direct themselves: `superpowers:brainstorming` first and respect its own sizing — when it concludes the change is a spike or bounded, implement it directly with `superpowers:test-driven-development` instead of writing a plan; otherwise `superpowers:writing-plans` (plan under temp/plans/) and `superpowers:subagent-driven-development` (implement, test and review each task with subagents). Finish with `superpowers:finishing-a-development-branch`, choosing to keep the branch as it is.

plugin.label: agentic-sdd-flow
plugin.instruction: Use the plugin entry point `/agentic-sdd-flow:dotnet-feature <TASK-KEY> <title>` end to end. Let the skill's own sizing gate choose the tier — never pass --tier and never overrule it. When a proposal or a spec is presented for approval, approve the recommended one and continue; when the workflow returns `plan_rejected`, fix the plan from its findings and rerun it; when it returns open questions, answer them with the most conservative reading of the criteria and rerun.
